name: DWBI
description: DWBI ('Don't Worry Bout It') is a citywide street gang alliance in Metro Detroit comprising multiple independent cliques that broadly identify under the local Blood umbrella. The network began consolidating around 2014 and operates through numerous affiliated sub-groups spread across Detroit's east and west sides. DWBI maintains rivalries with several other Detroit-area gangs while functioning as a loose coalition rather than a rigid hierarchical organization.

sources.title: USA v. Bowditch (2:22-mj-30273) – Michigan Eastern District Court
